Learning with leaders who inspire

Building school culture starts with connection

Because even leaders need a support system.

When it comes to our little ones, being prepared matters. ❤️

Our faculty recently took part in a First Aid Workshop with Dr Sushma Sanjay, gaining practical knowledge and confidence to respond calmly and effectively when it matters most.
.
Because creating a safe environment for children goes beyond the classroom. It means being prepared, staying informed and knowing what to do when every second counts.
.
Learning to care. Learning to respond. Learning to protect. 🩹❤️
.

This is what childhood looks like. ❤️
.
No posing. No rehearsing. No asking them to smile.
.
Just little faces lighting up, little bodies leaning closer, hands reaching out, questions flying, laughter spilling over and eyes following every word, every movement, every magical moment.
.
Our Pebbles & Pages photographs captured something far more precious than a programme. They captured children being completely, wonderfully themselves.
.
And perhaps nowhere was that more visible than during Gajapati Kulapati, when stories became real, curiosity took over and sheer joy needed no direction. 🐘📚✨
.
Ten little glimpses of big, unadulterated childhood happiness.
.
The kind you cannot script.
The kind you cannot stage.
The kind that simply happens when children feel completely at home in their world.
.
This is the childhood we want to remember. ❤️
